A '''fuel droid''',<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> or '''refueling droid''',<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used to refuel [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They were large, yellow machines that serviced [[Theed Spaceport]].
